scripts.build: npm run build -w @lims/core && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @lims/core && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @lims/core && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @lims/core && npm run dev -w web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @lims/core && npm run test:unit -w server
scripts.preview:build: npm run build -w @lims/core && npm run build:demo -w web && node scripts/package-preview.mjs
